## Goal
Preserve non-semantic recovery boundaries while allowing semantic exhaustion carryover through unchanged-evidence states.

## Acceptance Criteria
- R5 TOOLING_FAILURE does not produce semantic deferred findings.
- R5 structured coverage/header failures do not produce semantic deferred findings.
- R6 retryRecovery.recoveryPossible=false and unchanged-evidence do not block semantic carryover at maxAttempts.
- R9 manual review retry reset behavior remains covered.

## Implementation Notes
Do not route TOOLING_FAILURE or structured coverage failures through semantic deferral. Ensure retry recovery mutation does not prevent the terminal carryover path.

## Test Strategy
Focused tests for TOOLING_FAILURE, structured coverage failure, unchanged-evidence, retryRecovery.recoveryPossible=false, and retry reset preservation.
